Harbor illustration agreement — synthetic test fixture

Deliverables: three original illustrations for the client's homepage, about page, and campaign page.

Revisions: two rounds of changes within the agreed illustration scope are included.

Payment: the project fee is INR 18,000. A 40% deposit is due before work begins, with the remainder due on delivery.

Timeline: delivery is due within three weeks after the deposit and complete creative brief. Client feedback is required within two working days.

Exclusions: animation and additional illustration concepts are excluded and require a separate written agreement.

Ownership: final illustration rights transfer after full payment. The freelancer retains pre-existing brushes and reusable tools.
